summary_markdown: Someone reviewed the `facility_master_version` table and noted that the facility master data seems to have only recently started being recorded. [p1] confirmed that this feature was added only a week prior. It was discussed whether it would be possible to re-populate or rebuild the facility master data using existing aggregated data, which [p1] confirmed was feasible.
decisions: The facility master data can be rebuilt/reconstructed using existing aggregate data.
